[[Getting Started in Guild Wars]] is a tutorial [[quest]] in [[Guild Wars Prophecies]], designed to guide new players through their first steps in [[Ascalon (pre-Searing)|Ascalon]]. It is only visible to characters in [[Reforged Mode]].

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = pre
| test = n
| reforged = y
}}

===Objectives===
* Meet up with your profession trainer outside the city gate. Complete [[Profession Test|their test]].
* Meet up with [[Devona]] and complete [[Unsettling Rumors|her task]].
* Choose a [[secondary profession]]. Visit trainers to try out different [[skills]] from each profession. Once decided, return to '''[[Armin Saberlin]]'''.
* Speak with [[Sir Tydus]] when you are ready to proceed.
* Speak with any [[Town Crier]] to receive your reward.

===Reward===
* 500 [[Experience]]
* 100 [[Gold]]

==Walkthrough==
Step out of the gates of [[Ascalon City (pre-Searing)|Ascalon City]] into the idyllic meadows of [[Lakeside County]]. Your first task is to master the fundamentals of your chosen [[Primary Profession]]. Depending on your chosen profession, the available quest will vary:
* {{w}} [[Warrior Test]]
* {{r}} [[Ranger Test]]
* {{mo}} [[Monk Test]]
* {{n}} [[Necromancer Test]]
* {{me}} [[Mesmer Test]]
* {{e}} [[Elementalist Test]]

Accept your respective quest and complete it. Once you have proven your basic competence, travel southwest along the road to the village of [[Ashford]] to meet with [[Devona]]. She will task you with investigating some [[Unsettling Rumors]].

After you finish that quest, you must expand your horizons by selecting a secondary profession. '''Caution:''' Your choice of a secondary profession cannot be changed until [[Ascension|much later in the game]]; therefore, it is advised not to lock in your choice until you are done with adventuring in this area.

The following quests unlock a secondary profession:
* {{w}} [[Grawl Invasion]]
* {{r}} [[The Ranger's Companion]]
* {{mo}} [[A Monk's Mission]]
* {{n}} [[The Necromancer's Novice]]
* {{me}} [[A Mesmer's Burden]]
* {{e}} [[The Elementalist Experiment]]

After you have firmly locked in your secondary profession, return to Ascalon City and speak to Armin Saberlin. Accept the quest [[A Second Profession]] from him (if you haven't already done so) and accept the reward from that quest to proceed. Then speak to a Town Crier for your reward.
